name: Approved (standard)
source_text: SUP→DOC: classify_document ×n → extract_document ×n → SUP→IDV: verify_pan → ckyc_lookup → check_address_proof → SUP→SCR: sanctions_screen, pep_check → SUP→RSK: fetch_risk_policy(v3) → compute_risk_score → APPROVAL interrupt (approve) → create_customer_record(approval_token) → finalize_application(APPROVED) → reply
expansion: 'SUP→X' is the hand-off tool transfer_to_<agent>; '×n' is written once (order and multiplicity are not compared in superset mode); the APPROVAL interrupt and the reply are not tool calls.
